item.title: 第一代改良痘苗病毒安卡拉载体 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 疫苗 候选物与基于 mRNA 的加强剂 疫苗接种 的安全性和免疫原性:1 期试验
The impact of COVID-19 vaccination on long COVID prevention in the Omicron era: An updated systematic review and meta-analysis
item.description: 摘要 目的 通过更新的系统评价和荟萃分析,评估 新型冠状病毒感染 疫苗接种 对 Omicron 时代 长新冠 (LC) 预防的影响。方法我们对之前发布的 疫苗接种 和 LC 风险的系统评价和荟萃分析进行了更新(搜索时间为 2022 年 1 月 1 日至 2024 年 3 月 1 日)。检索了数据库(Embase、MEDLINE、PubMed、Europe PMC、LILACS、Cochrane 新型冠状病毒感染 研究注册中心)2024 年 3 月 1 日至 2026 年 7 月 13 日之间发表的研究。其中包括评估 疫苗接种 对 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染后 4 周或更长时间发生 LC 风险影响的观察性研究。疫苗 仅限于欧盟集中授权的人员。进行仅限于成人的随机效应荟萃分析,以计算三个比较中 LC 的汇总比值比 (OR):接种疫苗(任何剂量)与未接种疫苗;加强 疫苗接种 与未接种疫苗的比较;和强化课程 疫苗接种 与仅初级课程 疫苗接种 相比。结果 确定了 19 项新研究,其中 10 项与原始综述中的 8 项研究一起纳入更新的荟萃分析中。已接种疫苗的成人(任何剂量)与未接种疫苗的成人 LC 的汇总 OR 为 0.75(95% 置信区间 [CI] 0.67–0.84;13 项研究)。与未接种疫苗相比,加强 疫苗接种 的 OR 也较低(0.73;95% CI 0.65–0.82;6 项研究),加强 疫苗接种 与初级课程 疫苗接种 相比(0.63;95% CI 0.53–0.75;6 项研究)。在感染后三个月或更长时间仅使用 mRNA 的 疫苗接种 和 LC 结果的亚组分析中,观察到 疫苗接种 与较低的 LC 几率之间存在显着相关性。结论 这项更新的综述和荟萃分析强化了我们之前的发现,即 疫苗接种 可能会减轻 Omicron 时代 LC 的负担,而加强剂量可能会提供额外的保护。尽管目前大多数国家优先考虑 疫苗接种 的高风险人群的证据仍然有限,但这些发现清楚地证明了 疫苗接种 的益处并支持当前的季节性 疫苗接种 策略。

item.title: Telehealth-related education and training: a systematic review of recent developments since the COVID-19 pandemic
纵向 BCR 库动态揭示了异源 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 疫苗接种 和突破性感染后广泛结合抗体的 进化:单一供体案例研究
item.description: 持续的 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 抗原漂移和人畜共患 sarbecovirus 跨物种溢出 的持续风险突出表明需要采取广泛的保护性对策。在这里,我们纵向分析了接受异源加强 疫苗接种 后接受 Omicron BF.7 突破性感染的单个志愿者的 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 库,将批量 BCR 测序与单个 B 细胞培养和抗体结合分析相结合。突破性感染与 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 变体和相关 sarbecovirus 的血清中和作用扩大有关,这与针对保守表位的抗体的回忆一致。库分析揭示了阶段特异性重塑,高亲和力结合抗体从 疫苗接种 后富含 IGHV1-46 的谱转变为感染后优先表达 IGHV3-30-3。分离的单克隆抗体对多种动物源性 sarbecovirus 刺突表现出纳摩尔至皮摩尔的结合亲和力,通常具有广泛的结合,但并非普遍如此,与 14-16 个氨基酸的 CDRH3 长度相关。系统发育和序列分析定义了 IGHV1-46 和 IGHV3-30-3 谱系的不同进化轨迹,突出了需要在更大的 队列研究 中进行验证的候选遗传特征。总之,这些发现描述了连续的异源抗原暴露如何重塑个体的体液库,并为未来的泛沙病毒抗体和 疫苗 研究提供假设。

item.title: 对 Omicron XBB.1.5 疫苗、既往感染及其在 Omicron KP.3 波期间针对症状性 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 感染诱导的中和抗体的保护
家庭流感中 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 的前 Omicron 群体免疫力评估 疫苗 评估 (HIVE) 队列研究
item.description: 背景:持续进行 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 群体免疫血清调查对于 疫苗 菌株选择和易感群体(例如幼儿)的鉴定至关重要。我们的目标是评估使用高通量、低容量测定来描述基于 队列研究 的纵向跟踪社区中的菌株特异性 IgG 测量。方法:纵向家庭流感 疫苗 评估研究每年观察约 300 个家庭的急性呼吸道疾病。在 2021 年 7 月 1 日至 12 月 31 日期间抽取血清样本的参与者中,使用多重电化学发光 (ECL)、伪病毒中和 (PN) 和 ACE2 抑制测定法测量 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 变体特异性 IgG(包括原始、Delta、Beta 和 Omicron 变体)浓度。Spearman 等级相关系数评估了 ECL、ACE2 和 PN 测定内部和之间的相关性。受试者工作特征 (ROC) 分析评估了 ECL 和 ACE2 检测的性能。广义相加混合模型按年龄估计群体对 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 变体的免疫力。结果:本研究共选取了 117 名参与者的 156 份血清样本。大多数 (65.8%) 来自成人,大多数 (77.8%) 在分析期间接受了 疫苗接种。在 ECL IgG 检测 (0.95-1.00)、ACE2 抑制检测 (0.70-0.99) 以及检测平台之间观察到高度相关性,包括 ECL 与 PN (0.81-0.83) 以及 ACE2 与 PN (0.88-0.95)。严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 IgG 浓度通常随着年龄的增长而增加,并在成年早期趋于稳定,但由于样本量较小,在较年轻的年龄组中的估计值并不精确。结论:我们发现不同变体的 ECL、ACE2 和 PN 之间存在高度相关性。年龄特异性 IgG 数量反映了活跃的 监测 收集的行为和感染史。

item.title: Genomic surveillance of COVID-19 in Hong Kong (2020-2023): Analysing SARS-CoV-2 variants, mutations, and their impact on viral entry.
item.description: 摘要:我们分析了 2020 年至 2023 年间从 NCBI 和 GISAID 获得的来自香港的 15,982 个质量控制的 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 基因组 序列,以表征谱系动态、突变谱、人口统计分布和变体特异性病毒进入。基因组监测 鉴定了 543 个谱系和 5,982 个独特的 突变。A、B 和 B.4 谱系在最初的流行浪潮中占主导地位,而 Delta 和 Omicron 在后来的流行浪潮中出现并占主导地位。Omicron BA.1 和 BA.2 在性别和年龄组中表现出不同的分布,而 JN.1 则包含几个新颖的 突变。比较刺突受体结合域 (SRBD)-ACE2 相互作用的分子模拟揭示了变体之间结合亲和力的显着差异 (F = 4.404,p = 9.12 × 10−7)。JN.1 表现出增强的 ACE2 结合亲和力,表明病毒进入和潜在传播能力增加。通过整合基因组、人口统计和分子证据,本研究对香港的 进化 进化 进行了全面的描述,并强调了新出现的变异与公共卫生的相关性。这些发现支持持续的 基因组监测 和人口监测,以加强大流行病的防范。未来的研究应该评估公共卫生策略,并采用将人口特征与基因组证据相结合的整体框架,以减轻未来变异的影响。

item.title: 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 核衣壳蛋白通过靶向 eEF1A1 劫持 宿主 转录
item.description: 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 变体表现出巨大的遗传和表型多样性,但其对 宿主 基因调控影响的分子机制需要进一步研究。我们对 宿主 对多种 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 变体(包括 Delta 和 Omicron)的反应进行了转录组分析。尽管存在差异,但所有变体都会在人肺上皮细胞中诱导保守的转录程序,其特征是激活干扰素调节因子(IRF)、即早期基因和下游细胞因子。我们确定病毒核衣壳 (N) 蛋白是这种转录重编程的中心驱动因素,因为单独的 N 表达部分地概括了 宿主 对感染的反应。从机制上讲,N 促进干扰素调节因子和 AP-1 转录因子、RNA 聚合酶 II 和延伸因子 eEF1A1 募集到促炎基因的启动子,揭示了 eEF1A1 以前未被识别的核作用。使用 eEF1A 相互作用物 plitidepsin 从遗传或药理学上破坏 N-eEF1A1 相互作用,消除转录复合物形成并逆转 宿主 基因失调,识别保守的 宿主 病毒调节轴和潜在的泛变体治疗靶点。

item.title: A Genome-Wide Association Study in the Chilean admixed population reveals four new loci for COVID-19 severity and susceptibility
严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 二次暴露期间纵隔淋巴结生发中心动态区分时间依赖性和变异特异性免疫
item.description: 摘要:即使个体先前对自然感染或 疫苗接种 具有免疫力,严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 继发感染仍然是一个持续的挑战。然而,对于决定二次暴露是否受到预先存在的免疫力快速控制并导致消毒保护或进展为生产性感染和疾病的细胞机制仍知之甚少。在 C57BL/6J 小鼠中使用同源和异源二次攻击实验策略,我们表明,对先前感染的小鼠的同源 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 Alpha 二次攻击的保护是有时间限制的,在初次感染后 56 天保持持久,在初次感染后第 84 天突破感染。这种保护的丧失与中和抗体滴度的减弱无关,而是与纵隔淋巴结中滤泡辅助T细胞和生发中心B细胞的进行性收缩相关。相比之下,先前感染α的小鼠中的异源β二次暴露始终未能产生强有力的生发中心反应,尽管与同源再次攻击相比动员了相当或更多数量的免疫细胞。相反,RNA-seq 和流式细胞术分析表明,这种反应与滤泡外 B 细胞炎症反应相关,其特征是 Bcl6 和 Aicda 表达减少,同时 Il6 强烈上调。总而言之,这些发现确定纵隔淋巴结中的生发中心回忆反应是 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 二次免疫的重要细胞相关性,并对加强免疫的时机和交叉变体 疫苗 的设计具有直接影响。

item.title: National flu and COVID-19 surveillance report: 15 October 2026 (week 42) - GOV.UK
item.description: The National Flu and COVID-19 Surveillance Report for 15 October 2026 (week 42) provides an overview of respiratory virus activity in England. It notes that influenza activity remained stable and at baseline levels, with some indicators showing decreased activity among young adults. RSV activity increased and was circulating at baseline levels. For SARS-CoV-2, the report indicates mixed trends and low-level circulation, with 1,848 confirmed cases in hospital settings during week 41. The rolling 7-day positivity rate for SARS-CoV-2 in hospitals was 8.8%, stable compared to the previous week, and highest among those aged 85 years and over at 13.5%. The report highlights that some pharmacy vaccination data was incomplete, leading to the exclusion of certain age groups and clinical risk groups from analysis. It also notes that testing policies may change, affecting positivity rates, and that data from previous seasons is aligned by day. The report is based on data up to week 41, which ended on 11 October 2026.

item.title: COVID-19 Ensemble Forecasts - Centers for Disease Control and Prevention | CDC (.gov)
item.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) published an article on October 16, 2026, titled 'COVID-19 Ensemble Forecasts.' The content outlines the CDC's ongoing efforts to monitor and model the spread of SARS-CoV-2, emphasizing the use of ensemble forecasting techniques to predict future trends. The article does not report on a specific outbreak or event but instead provides general information about public health strategies. It highlights the importance of using secure, official websites for sensitive information and mentions the CDC's role in translating scientific data into practical policy. The article does not include specific case counts, death counts, or exposure numbers, focusing instead on the broader implications of forecasting for public health preparedness.

item.title: COVID-19 dashboard
item.description: The WHO COVID-19 dashboard provides a global summary of confirmed SARS-CoV-2 cases and deaths, with data collected from countries, territories, and areas. It includes information on case definitions, testing strategies, and reporting practices, which vary by region. The dashboard has been updated since March 2020, with weekly data from July 2023 onwards. Data is subject to continuous verification and may change due to retrospective updates or shifts in reporting standards. WHO acknowledges that case detection, testing, and reporting practices differ globally, which can lead to under or overestimation of true case and death counts. Additionally, some countries have stopped reporting or changed their reporting frequency, which may affect the completeness of the data. The dashboard serves as a tool for monitoring the pandemic's spread and impact, but it is important to note that the data reflects official reports and may not capture all cases or deaths accurately.

item.title: CDC issues reminder on ending of the emergency authorization for COVID-19 in vitro diagnostics tests - American Hospital Association
item.description: On October 14, 2026, the CDC issued a reminder that the emergency authorization for certain in vitro diagnostic tests for SARS-CoV-2, the virus causing COVID-19, is ending. This update is relevant to hospitals and health systems across the United States, as the American Hospital Association (AHA) published the notice. The event is an official regulatory action by the CDC, confirmed as a policy change. No specific case counts, death counts, or exposure numbers are reported, and the risk level is not explicitly stated. The CDC's action signals the conclusion of emergency measures for these diagnostic tests, which may affect healthcare operations and testing practices. The AHA is involved in communicating this information, and the source is fully available with no reported uncertainties. This change is part of the broader regulatory landscape for managing the pandemic and its aftermath.

item.title: COVID-19 Vaccine Boosters During Pregnancy Protect Against Preeclampsia - Infectious Disease Special Edition
item.description: The article titled 'COVID-19 Vaccine Boosters During Pregnancy Protect Against Preeclampsia' published by Infectious Disease Special Edition on October 17, 2026, discusses the potential protective effects of COVID-19 vaccine boosters during pregnancy against preeclampsia. However, the evidence provided does not include specific outbreak details, case counts, or risk levels. The content is a review article and does not report on any confirmed or suspected events related to SARS-CoV-2. The article highlights the importance of vaccine boosters in maternal health but does not provide data on their impact or any public health response measures. The source is a reputable medical publication, and the information is presented as a general review rather than a specific outbreak or event.

item.title: 弗林蛋白酶位点附近的糖衣引导 严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2 跨变体的尖峰加工 - Bioengineer.org
item.description: A study published on October 16, 2026, by researchers at the Center for Infection and Immunity of Lille in Scientific Reports reveals that N-linked glycans near the S1/S2 boundary of the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein play a crucial role in its processing by host proteases. These glycans, located at asparagine residues 603, 616, and 657, influence how the spike is cleaved and its ability to mediate cell fusion and entry. The research found that removing these glycans caused spike processing to rely on the R634 residue, indicating a functional redundancy. The study compared these effects across the D614, G614, and XBB.1.5 variants, showing that the functional roles of these glycans and residues have evolved over time. The findings suggest that mutations near the S1/S2 boundary should not be overlooked, as they may impact viral entry efficiency depending on the genetic background. This research contributes to understanding the molecular mechanisms of SARS-CoV-2 and could inform future surveillance and therapeutic strategies.

item.title: Promising COVID-19 antiviral pill, Paxlovid, in scarce supply, as doctors, patients compete for access - ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
item.description: The article discusses the limited supply of Paxlovid, a promising antiviral pill for treating severe cases of COVID-19, in the United States. Approved by federal regulators in late 2021, the drug has been in short supply, with three-quarters of U.S. counties having no Paxlovid on hand as of January 27, 2022. California, among other states, received only 9,560 doses, which is about 24 prescriptions per 100,000 people. The scarcity has led to competition among doctors and patients, with some states prioritizing high-risk individuals, including those who initially refused vaccination. The White House and Pfizer have acknowledged the slow rollout due to manufacturing constraints, with plans to increase supply to 20 million courses by the end of September. The drug's effectiveness is noted as reducing hospitalization and death by 88% for high-risk patients, but its distribution remains uneven, raising concerns about health equity and access.

item.title: Covid-19: XBB wave detected, Health Ministry foresees slight increase in cases - NST Online
item.description: The Malaysian Health Ministry has confirmed the detection of the Omicron XBB subvariant, which is expected to cause a slight increase in Covid-19 cases in the coming weeks. However, so far, the strain has not resulted in a significant rise in hospital admissions or deaths. Caretaker Health Minister Khairy Jamaluddin urged the public to remain vigilant but not alarmed, as the country is transitioning to an endemic phase. The ministry is using existing infection models to project the spread of the XBB variant and plans to provide more accurate data next week. Additionally, the ministry has been in communication with Singapore's Health Minister regarding the cross-border spread of the virus, though no additional measures have been introduced for individuals traveling between Malaysia and Singapore. The situation remains under active monitoring, with no explicit risk level communicated at this time.
